counterfactual_missing_items: T2 and non–contrast T1 sequences revealed no intratumoral hemorrhage or cystic change
without dural enhancement or intracranial extension
decisive_items: mass at the level of the left middle turbinate extending into the left nasal roof and eroding the upper nasal septum

expansile, mildly enhancing soft-tissue mass in the anterosuperior nasal cavity encroaching on the left orbital cavity, with remodeling of the left medial orbital wall and extension to the level of the cribriform plate
cystic mass occupying the left fronto-ethmoid region with destruction of the anterior skull base and erosion of the left lamina papyracea
response.rationale: R2 best reconciles the anterior nasal-vault/olfactory-region mass with septal erosion, orbital and cribriform involvement, and anterior skull-base destruction while the intact dura suggests an extra-axial/locally aggressive process. R1 is less complete because the frontal sinus retention and cystic appearance can be secondary sinus obstruction above the solid enhancing mass; R3 is the least specific for the superior nasal/olfactory pattern and does not integrate the orbital-proptosis pathway as well.

rejected.why: Its supports are generic erosive sinonasal mass features and do not discriminate the cribriform/olfactory-vault localization with orbital and anterior skull-base damage as directly as R2.
